name: Chicago Emergency 2026
description: Chicago-area emergency infrastructure snapshot, fetched 2026-11-16 from the Chicago Data Portal and OpenStreetMap. Public-access AEDs and Stop-the-Bleed kits, fire and police stations, library branches usable as daytime warming/cooling refuge, DFSS community service centers and senior centers used as warming sites, and hospitals with an emergency department. This is a dated snapshot of published open data, not a curated list - hours and device placement drift, and most AED/bleed-kit markers sit inside buildings only reachable when the building is open. Known defect: the DFSS dataset reports M-F 9am-5pm for all six centers; those are the primary extreme-cold warming centers and actually run extended or 24-hour hours during an activation. Those notes are hand-corrected. Call 311 to confirm before relying on any of this.
